content: Mɛ undweer, an'sɔ̈ɔ̈n Gäyus, awà in'kwen mɛ unsà pɛɛlà a ndandaa.
Nkwen amɛ, mɛ in'kwen naa ngye aböŋ unsà indiir byanswà, akäl ubwaŋ, anà un'swey a mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye ukyen usà.
Abun, mɛ kàsäŋ mbɔɔn, ntɔn atɔŋ bàyi pà bàmutà imbäl a ndandaa ikamɛnà u mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye: ngye, ngye awà uboo a ndandaa.
Un'sak amɛ wà mbɔɔn muwem naa mɔ̈ɔ̈ a baan amɛ wà uboo a ndandaa.
Un'sam, ngye awà wàlää unsà indiir akyerà ngye ntɔn atɔŋ, itàkal ntɔn angyey.
Ba bàtɛ imbäl a un'kaay angye kusà a Ikööŋ. Ngye asàkyer ubwaŋ mukapà indiir byanswà abà ba abyà mfun ntɔn nkyeen aba, asànaa ukwen Nzam.
Yà ntɔn ikɔb a Yɛsu waa ba bàwɛl mbwo mukyà, ukɔɔn akyey akà undiir mwɛy akà baar mpa abà Ayudà.
Abun, abà buur abi mukaar baar a tub abà, anà bi mukal abaay ntɔn ndandaa.
Mɛ kàsɔ̈ɔ̈n Ikööŋ undiir mwɛy, wɛɛ Dyɔtɛrfɛs awà akwen muyaal indiir byanswà, nde bi ufiwal anki.

Mpal in'yàyà mɛ sye, mɛ in'kyer ayàsà kà imɛɛy nsyääl ande, nde mbuur afàpay làsaŋ a làbe ntɔn bi: kà nà ntɔn abwɛy mpel anki, nde kàkyer atɔn nde ŋakwo muwal atɔŋ abà bàlyaaŋ. Baar abà bàlàwal atɔŋ abà, nde ba kàkyer atsuŋ anà kàkyer aböŋ kà Ikööŋ.
Un'sam amɛ, twon an'lab ube, wɛɛ lab ubwaŋ. Mbuur afàkyer ubwaŋ wà wà Nzam, mbuur afàkyer ube uyöb anki Nzam.
Wɛɛ, ntɔn Dɛmɛtiris, mbuur wanswà afun'tɛɛl imbäl aŋàbwaŋ. Ndandaa ŋakwo yàmutà imbäl ntɔn nde. Wɛɛ bi sye, bi kun'tɛɛl imbäl, anà ngye akyàyɔ̈b naa imbäl a bi kyà ndandaa.
Mɛ in'yàkal anà indiir mukasöön, wɛɛ mɛ in'kwen anki mukyer anà tin anà inzar.
Ntɔn, mɛ in'sii mukaman itaan a mbɔɔn tɛy anà bi, bi ikyer asàyäm u ndaa a duu.
Wɛy duu làkäl anà ngye. Atɔŋ angye bàmapà mbɔr. Mbɔr akà asam, akà mbuur mbuur ukɔl.
